rows.name: Hidden Mountain 345 kV Station
rows.quote: Hidden Mountain 345 kV Station (2024 Waiver Granted) This project consists of a new 345 kV station (Hidden Mountain) on the existing Pajarito-Western Spirit 345 kV line in central New Mexico.
rows.owner: Public Service Company of New Mexico

rows.name: Pajarito 345 kV Station Expansion
rows.quote: Pajarito 345 kV Station Expansion (New 2026 Waiver Request) The project consists of expanding the Pajarito 345 kV station to accommodate the interconnection of a 150 BESS generation facility. The in-service date is 2027.
rows.owner: Public Service Company of New Mexico

rows.name: Hidden Mountain 345 kV Expansion
rows.quote: Hidden Mountain 345 kV Expansion (New 2026 Waiver Request) This project consists of expanding the Hidden Mountain 345 kV station for two additional 345/115 kV transformers. The in-service date is 2028.
rows.owner: Public Service Company of New Mexico

rows.name: Rio Puerco-Pajarito-Prosperity 345 kV Lines
rows.quote: Rio Puerco-Pajarito-Prosperity 345 kV Lines (New 2026 Waiver Request) The project consists of constructing a new 345 kV station (Prosperity) in southeast Albuquerque, construction of two 345 kV lines: Rio Puerco-Pajarito (34 miles), Pajarito-Prosperity (0.47 miles) and looping the existing Pajarito-Sandia 345 kV line into Prosperity 345 kV station. The in-service date is 2029.
rows.owner: Public Service Company of New Mexico
